lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Israel's shepherds, who eat the fat and wear the wool but do not feed the flock.
The shepherds ruled with violence and cruelty, and the scattered sheep became food for all the wild beasts.
The LORD will remove the shepherds, search for His flock Himself, and bring them from the countries into their own fortress.
The LORD will judge between fat and lean sheep, save His flock, and appoint one shepherd, His servant Moses.
